generation_model_note.conclusion: Both the logical-entailment dataset creation pipeline and the NeMo Curator DiverseQA dataset pipeline used Nemotron 3 Super 120B A12B-equivalent generation.
generation_model_note.curator_diverseqa: Actual Curator run manifests record provider model nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3-super-v3 and tokenizer nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-FP8. Per project clarification on 2026-07-09, the catalog shorthand nvidia/nemotron-3-super-v3 and the actual hosted identifier nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3-super-v3 are exact-equivalent to nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b for this provenance comparison.
generation_model_note.logical_entailment: Configured/default Stage 1A LE model is nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b via nim-llm-super-120b-bw.
